title: Bramley: plague spreaders are the Sumerian overlord faction
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Bramley: plague spreaders are the Sumerian overlord faction, about Sumerian era to 14th century at Sumer; Europe, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He thinks that basically these uh you know uh plague promulgators >> Mhm. are um representing the same faction that was lording over humanity in the Sumerian epoch

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, explained on Jesse Michels' podcast an idea from the writer William Bramley's book The Gods of Eden. According to Jorjani, Bramley thinks the people who spread plagues in Europe, such as in the 1300s, belonged to the same group that ruled over humanity back in ancient Sumer, the early civilisation of what is now Iraq. If true, it would mean one hidden, non-human-linked faction has steered human history for thousands of years.
